problemStatement: An industrial robot dress pack guides a flexible robotic cable through a local bend. Model the cable locally as an equivalent circular cable following a circular arc. Use cable diameter d = {{robot_cable_d_mm}} {{robot_cable_d_mm_unit}} and specified inner bend radius Ri = {{robot_cable_Ri_mm}} {{robot_cable_Ri_mm_unit}}.
engineeringGoal: Determine the neutral-axis radius, centerline curvature, and maximum equivalent geometric longitudinal bending strain; then assess the route against the documented minimum inner bend-radius factor without claiming constituent stress or fatigue life.
